key.name: window-width
key.description: Last width of the main window, in logical pixels.

key.name: window-height
key.description: Last height of the main window, in logical pixels.

key.name: window-maximized
key.description: Whether the main window was maximized when it was last closed.

key.name: vault-path
key.description: Absolute path of the configured journal; empty when none is configured.

key.name: auto-lock-minutes
key.description: Minutes of inactivity before the vault locks; 0 never locks.

key.name: lock-on-session-lock
key.description: Whether locking the session also locks the vault.

key.name: writing-font
key.description: Which font the entry editor uses: serif, sans, mono or custom.

key.name: custom-font
key.description: A Pango font description used when the writing font is custom.

key.name: text-size
key.description: Entry text size in points, between 14 and 26.

key.name: line-width
key.description: Editor text column width: narrow, comfortable or wide.

key.name: details-visible
key.description: Whether the right details panel is shown; open on first run and remembered afterwards.

key.name: spell-languages
key.description: Comma-separated spell checking language codes; empty follows the system default.

key.name: new-entry-type
key.description: What the New button creates: journal, or a dream before 10:00 and a journal page after.

key.name: markdown-symbols
key.description: How Markdown syntax characters are shown; version 1.0 offers only dimmed.

key.name: backups-enabled
key.description: Whether Quaderno snapshots the journal automatically, weekly.

key.name: backup-folder
key.description: Folder for automatic backups; empty uses the default under the app data directory.
